summary.text: Bill DeSteph is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia for District 20, serving since 2016. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Commerce and Labor, Privileges and Elections, and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Bill DeSteph was born in Hartford, Connecticut, on October 28, 1964, according to the Senate's member page.
The page says he earned a B.S. in finance from the University of Maryland and lists his occupation as retired U.S. Naval Reserve.
The page lists him as a member of the House from 2014 to 2016 and a member of the Senate since 2016.
